column1: # npm audit waivers for the dependency_scan job.
# Columns are TAB separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A waiver only silences an advisory confined to devDependencies. Anything
# reaching the production tree fails the job whatever is listed here.
# Past its expiry date a waiver stops working and the job fails again, so
# every entry comes back for review instead of becoming permanent. Keep
# the reason specific: why it cannot be fixed, and what would clear it.

column3: braces <=3.0.3 stack exhaustion, dev-only: @next/eslint-plugin-next 16.3.8 -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces. Runs only under `npm run lint` on glob patterns from eslint.config.mjs, and is not in .next/standalone, so it is not in the runtime image. Every published braces is affected, so there is nothing to upgrade to. Clears when braces ships a fix or @next/eslint-plugin-next drops fast-glob. Same advisory and expiry as the NibTera waiver.
